# SugarMount

> SugarMount is the Google Play developer name of simpest, an independent developer in Korea. It publishes small Android apps that each do one thing simply. Photo, video and document apps process files on the device without uploading them, no app requires an account, and every app has its own privacy policy written from its code. Contact: sugarmount21@gmail.com. Korean pages live at /, English pages at /en/.

## Apps

- [SugarSpeller / 한글 띄어쓰기](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarspeller/): Fixes Korean spelling and spacing in one pass, from pasted or shared text. Package com.sugarmount.sugarspeller, on Google Play.
- [SugarCard / 생생카드](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarcard/): Pick a greeting card for holidays, birthdays and seasons, and send it right away. Package com.sugarmount.sugarcard, on Google Play.
- [SugarAlbum / 슈가앨범](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugaralbum/): Pick photos, get a video. Package com.sugarmount.sugaralbum, on Google Play.
- [SugarClip / SugarClip](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarclip/): Copy text and it goes to your note app, and into your clip history. Package com.sugarmount.sugarclip, on Google Play.
- [Compress Image / 사진 용량 줄이기](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-compress/): Shrinks photos under a size limit, like 100 KB or 500 KB. Package com.sugarmount.sugarcompress, on Google Play.
- [Flip & Rotate Image / 사진 반전·회전](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-flip/): Flip and rotate photos, saved as new files. Package com.sugarmount.sugarflip, coming soon.
- [Convert Image JPG PNG WEBP / 이미지 변환 JPG·PNG·WebP](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-convert/): HEIC, PNG and WebP to JPG and more, in batches. Package com.sugarmount.sugarconvert, coming soon.
- [SugarDoc HWP, HWPX & PDF Viewer / 슈가독 HWP·HWPX·PDF 뷰어](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/doc-viewer/): Open Korean HWP/HWPX documents and PDFs you receive, and find them again. Package com.sugarmount.sugardoc, coming soon.
- [Arrow Knots / 화살표 매듭풀기](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/arrow-knots/): Slide tangled arrows out one by one and clear the board. Package com.sugarmount.arrows, on Google Play.
- [Block Turn / 한판블록](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/privacy/blocks/): A block puzzle: turn a stuck board around with three set pieces. Package com.sugarmount.blocks, in Play review.

## Facts

- Who makes SugarMount apps? SugarMount is the developer name used by simpest, an independent developer, to publish apps on Google Play. Planning, development and support are all done by the same person.
- Are my photos or documents uploaded? Compress Image, Flip & Rotate Image, Convert Image, SugarDoc and SugarAlbum process files on your device without uploading them. SugarSpeller sends the text you check to the Naver or Daum spelling checker. Each app's privacy policy has the details.
- Are the apps free? All apps are free to install. Some show ads and offer ad removal or Pro features as a one-time purchase or subscription. SugarDoc has no ads.
- How do I get support or report a bug? Email sugarmount21@gmail.com. Including the app name, device model and Android version helps us check faster.
